requirement_summary: Figma is the sole authoritative production and evidence provider
Provider rationale is argued against the accepted contract requirements not general preference
Stitch is excluded from MA-025 and any later ideation use needs its own external-write gate
No Figma or Stitch MCP is configured or exposed on this host and the software-definition claim is stale
B07 is not authorizable because the 3D storyboard is not started and MA-004 is blocked
B09 is not authorizable because it hard-requires B07
The section 15 handoff and docs/ui/UI_SPEC.md cannot complete under MA-025
Seven batches execute strictly serially
B01 is a gated pilot and releases B02 to B08
Per-batch scope is taken verbatim from the accepted batch plan and is not extended
Eight permitted external operations confined to one approved file
Eleven prohibited external operations including all Stitch operations and all billing actions
Repository writes confined to the package plus durable root records
No commit push branch switch tag or history rewrite without explicit founder instruction
Capability enablement path A or path B must complete and be recorded before the first write
Six evidence unit types are produced and TEST_CAPTURE is excluded
WCAG 2.2 Level AA remains a target and no conformance claim is made
Evidence naming uses the accepted grammar unchanged
Coverage spans templates route instances profiles viewports modes states and time-limit branches
All copy is a marked reference fixture and gated facts are never invented
Only D-035 brand assets and semantic tokens are used
Local evidence tree is provider independent
Deterministic export scale uppercase SHA-256 hashing and the D-037 freeze algorithm
The file key is recorded and credentials never are
Eight-step per-batch produce validate inspect review revise revalidate exit loop
Three producer revisions per batch and exhaustion escalates as a change request
The producer may not review or approve their own batch
Founder gates are MA-025 the B01 pilot acceptance and MA-026
Zero spend free tier single editor and any paid step routes to MA-010
Five Figma free-tier limits are unverified and must be verified and dated before the first write
No personal client-confidential or protected GLB material enters the provider
Twelve enumerated stop conditions halt work rather than routing around a gate
Per-batch _PRE and _EXIT named checkpoints with exported archives
The repository export not provider version history is the authoritative rollback artifact
Accepted batch evidence is immutable and corrections create a new revision
Eight credential-handling rules with official flows only and no secret ever in the repository
Six conditions define acceptance of MA-025 itself
Eleven conditions define acceptance of an individual batch
MA-025 completion does not accept Phase 1 or approve the final visual direction
MA-013 compatibility acceptance remains a separate unaffected gate
